title: Okay at first…
body: The game starts off pretty fun. Like all of these games, the higher you get, the harder it is to finish items. But it’s gotten significantly worse the higher I get to compete in events or complete mini objectives. Basically you have to spend real money if you want to do anything. For instance, competing against others to complete orders fastest gives a lot of energy to continue playing, but when you get even slightly higher you’re at a significant disadvantage because you only have enough energy to finish (if you’re lucky) one order. Each level consists of 7 orders to be fulfilled (usually 1 single item order, and 6 that need at least two items each) After that you’re stuck waiting long periods of time to get enough energy. I have literally been trying to complete one single order for three days now, and I’m only about 1/2 done with the required pieces. The item generators also have severe limits, so even though I have enough energy, I cannot make the needed items, and there is nothing else to do but close the game and wait. (Unless you’re willing to spend money, because of course you can spend a few dollars and temporarily speed up the generators.) The generators also can be upgraded, but it’s random which pieces you get. So you end of with a lot of generators taking up space on your limited board. You can of course spend money to get gems to unlock storage slots. But getting the gems without spending is pretty much impossible. It costs 25 gems to unlock the next slot on mine (it increases each time) so I can only store 12 items now. I would need at least 20-25 unlocked to store the generators I don’t need. Without spending gems for a while, I currently have managed to get about 10 slots. So yeah, at this rate it would probably take me over a year to unlock enough slots for the useless and un-upgraded generators. Overall the gameplay is fun, same as any other merge game, but beyond that I cannot recommend the game unless you’re willing to spend at least $10 a week to play it or deal with massive headaches from needing one generator that will only produce a handful of items at a time, limited space on your board because of all the other generators, and limited gems and overly long cooking times (which again, you can spend real money to speed up) it’s overly monetized to the point it’s no fun, and not really worth playing as it is now.
